notes.title: THANK YOU!
notes.content:
Hi all, Tom here!

I just wanted to post a quick update to say a big THANK YOU to everyone for trying Upfall! It's been out for less than a week and we're already sitting at a Positive rating on Steam. That's AWESOME! This game was a bit of a shot in the dark (pun intended) as it's not a puzzle game and it's definitely a little freaky... so it's been so lovely to see people enjoying it and even completing some of it's more difficult challenges!

I also pushed a hotfix recently which fixes a small visual bug and gives a bit of a hint about how to unlock one of the trickier achievements. If you see a strange looking symbol in a bubble, make sure you pop it and check the main menu... you might find some breadcrumbs.

Finally, if you've enjoyed playing, do please drop a review for Upfall. It really does help with visibility (especially closer to launch) as it means we're more likely to show up in people's discovery queues. And who doesn't want, as one review says: "a slightly creepy echoing voice to tell them to keep going"? In a sense, isn't that what we all need right now? Especially as you can take it with you on the go if you have Steam Deck!

See you all in the reverb dimension...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570280/Upfall/

- Amicable Animal

notes.title: Upfall will launch on the 19th of May
notes.content:
Hi all, Tom here!

I'm delighted to announce that Upfall will launch on Steam, totally utterly free, in just one week's time. This game has been a bit of a labour of love and an experiment into visuals, sounds and vibes, so I hope you enjoy it. I worked with my friend eggysworld (who did the awesome sprites) to make something a little different, but distinctly Amicable Animal. Take a look below:

[previewyoutube=pNU2b42XLdY;full][/previewyoutube]

So... what is Upfall? It's a game designed to be played in those small gaps in your day. On your lunch break, when something else is downloading, when you need a quick distraction. Each run takes between 2 and 10 minutes and the aim is simple: SURVIVE. Bounce off of bubbles, avoid anything that looks glowy and mean, and see if you can make it back to the surface. As you play you'll unlock new palettes for the game, new instruments for it to play, new ways for it to sound, and even new modes and characters.

So... why is Upfall? Long story short, I was struggling with the state of the world while working on my other game, CRT7, and I needed a break. After a local game jam event I decided I wanted to polish up what I'd made and release it in order to maybe help me get my mojo back. Plus, let's be real: the world is pretty awful for a lot of people right now, and I thought it would be nice to give something back for free. No strings attached, no expectation of anything from you if you play it, just something out there for anyone who wants it. Don't worry, CRT7 is still coming, and I'll be back working on it again soon, hopefully with new found vigour!

Oh, and if you have a PS4/PS5 controller, I strongly recommend you try to play the game with that. And don't forget to look down, as you might see something fun going on with the controller!

That's it really! In one week you'll get a chance to play the game and discover what it is about for yourself. Oh, and of course I've put in some little secrets to unlock too... I really hope you enjoy it!

- Amicable Animal
